title: Google Trends Scraper input
description: Enter keywords or Google Trends URLs. Each keyword produces one result with interest over time, interest by region, related queries and related topics.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords to look up on Google Trends, for example "web scraping" or "bitcoin". Each term becomes one result, unless you turn on "Compare terms".

startUrls.title: Google Trends URLs
startUrls.description: Optional. Paste Google Trends explore URLs (https://trends.google.com/trends/explore?q=...). The keywords, country, date, category and property are read from each URL, and terms separated by commas in the URL are compared together.

compareTerms.title: Compare terms
compareTerms.description: Compare the search terms against each other on one shared 0-100 scale, like typing several terms on the Google Trends website. Terms are grouped in batches of up to 5 (the Google Trends limit), and each batch becomes one result.

geo.title: Country or region
geo.description: Two-letter country code (US, BR, DE), or a region code such as US-CA or BR-SP. Leave empty for worldwide.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Period to analyze. Ignored when you fill in "Custom time range".

customTimeRange.title: Custom time range
customTimeRange.description: Optional. Two dates separated by a space, in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example "2024-01-01 2024-12-31". Overrides "Time range".

category.title: Category
category.description: Limit results to a Google Trends category.

property.title: Google property
property.description: Which Google search to measure: regular web search, image search, news search, Google Shopping or YouTube search.

sections.title: Data to collect
sections.description: Which parts of the Google Trends page to collect. Fewer sections make the run faster.

regionResolution.title: Region level
regionResolution.description: Level of detail for "Interest by region". Automatic uses countries for worldwide searches and states or provinces for a single country. Metro areas (DMA) exist only for the US.

includeLowVolumeRegions.title: Include low search volume regions
includeLowVolumeRegions.description: Also return regions with little search volume, which Google Trends hides by default.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of topic names and labels, as a Google language code such as en-US, pt-BR or de.

trendingNowCountries.title: Trending now: countries
trendingNowCountries.description: Optional. Two-letter country codes (US, BR, IN...) to also collect today's trending searches with approximate traffic and related news articles. Each trending search becomes one result.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many searches run at the same time. Google Trends limits fast traffic, so low values are more reliable.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per request
maxRetries.description: How many times a request is retried, with an increasing pause, when Google Trends answers "too many requests" or another temporary error.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy servers used for the requests. Apify Proxy is recommended.
